item.title: Save a plan without adding reminders
item.summary: Murph can save an accepted walking or habit plan around a cue like before lunch, without asking for an exact clock time when reminders are off.
item.details: The saved plan stays linked to your goal. Choosing quiet support keeps reminders off, and you can ask to change or pause the plan. If you shift the start, a quiet plan’s relative first-week review moves with it.
